digest.component_or_area: Pass-1 ladder and model escalation (plan-review and code-review gates)
propositions: Pass-1 ladder entries (haiku/sonnet/opus) are bare Anthropic model IDs hardcoded in plan-review.yaml; batch runners copy model_ladder[0] directly to cfg.model, bypassing class resolution and causing split-brain selection of Anthropic models even when a non-default provider is configured
Escalation via models_at_or_above() returns bare Anthropic model names regardless of provider, causing context-limit recovery to silently switch to direct Anthropic from Bedrock

Model ladder resolution must use reserved class names (trivial/standard/frontier) routed through model_classes.resolve_model_string, which already exists and is tested; this wiring has no single funnel but rather multiple call sites (config.resolve_model, batch runners, verifier paths, and DefaultBatchRunner.run)

sizing.MODEL_LADDER serves two purposes (escalation order and P8 context-window budget via substring match); it must remain unchanged with bare names, and models_at_or_above must map rungs through class config while preserving the substring-match positioning logic
config.py must lazily import model_classes inside resolve_model function body to avoid a circular import cycle that already exists in shipped code
workflow/runners.py:120 (DefaultBatchRunner.run) is a third ladder consumer with the identical model_ladder[0] split-brain, not previously enumerated
